title: The Themify Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'data' parameter in all…
description: The Themify Builder plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'data' parameter affecting all versions up to and including 7.8.5. Authenticated users with contributor-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages.
